notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.
